title: An empirical evaluation of imbalanced data strategies from a practitioner's point of view
reasoning: The paper is a technical empirical evaluation of machine learning strategies for imbalanced data. While it mentions the criticality of misclassification in disease detection as motivation for the problem, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics within AI systems.
